# Accessibility Statement

`tech-archive` is committed to keeping computer science notes, system design guides, and code examples clear, navigable, and accessible to all learners.

## Documentation & Content Standards
- **Semantic Structure:** Notes and combined study guides use hierarchical Markdown headings (`#`, `##`, `###`), concise tables, and bulleted lists rather than unformatted walls of text or screenshots of text.
- **Diagrams & Visuals:** System architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and visual breakdowns include descriptive alt-text and accompanying text explanations.
- **Accessible Code Blocks:** All code snippets specify explicit language tags (e.g., `python`, `cpp`, `java`, `sql`) for syntax highlighting and screen-reader clarity.
- **Descriptive Links:** External references and cross-linked topic guides use meaningful link text rather than raw URLs or generic labels like "click here."

## Feedback & Improvements
If you encounter formatting barriers, missing diagram descriptions, or readability issues anywhere in the archive, please open an issue so we can improve it.
